title: Client Portal Reset
scenario: A client email asks staff to reset portal credentials via a link.

answers.A: Act immediately because the request sounds urgent and important.
answers.B: Reply to the sender asking them to confirm the request.
answers.C: Use the approved company system or verified process.
answers.D: Escalate to IT, finance, HR, legal, or your manager through official channels.

explanation: Client Portal Reset: the trap is to get access to an account, code, password, or permission. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Use known client portal URLs, not email links.
